verdict.rationale: Jev provides a Playground where users can paste state and add live questions (Noul/Choice/Score) to test the API interactively, which offers some runnable-example experience, but there is no evidence of a true interactive API reference (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger UI with 'try it' buttons); a probe explicitly found openapi.json and swagger.json endpoints returning 404. Missing for 10: an OpenAPI/Swagger-style interactive reference, in-docs runnable code snippets, and any hands-on evidence beyond the Playground's basic quickstart flow.
